title: A page control left undecided while its words are written is kept, so R10b does not end the plan step
steps: S1: In the TCH checkout with dependencies installed, run run.cmd.
S2: Confirm every test named in run.tests reports ok.
expect: An undecided page control whose label the decision writes is added to the decision's links with its label slot.
A tab whose words are hidden, and an undecided link of any other kind, stay with the planner.
On the JA Diner 1.0.8 kit, block-97 keeps its three tabs and its hidden go-to link stays hidden.

tests: an undecided page control whose words the decision writes is kept; undecided links of any other kind stay with the planner
JA Diner 1.0.8: the menu block whose tab labels the plan writes keeps its three tabs, and its go-to link stays hidden
a hidden page control whose words the decision writes is kept; any other hidden link takes its written label with it
